name: Platinum Vape | 2g Disposable | Nightcap
description:
Smooth. Seductive. The perfect way to clock out.

Nightcap is a rich, full-bodied blend with creamy notes of grape, berry, and vanilla that melt together for the ultimate evening unwind. Packed with pure Platinum distillate, it delivers a deep, relaxing high that quiets the mind and settles the body — your go-to for late nights and laid-back vibes.

The rechargeable 2G all-in-one device features advanced airflow and dual-coil heating for consistent, flavorful hits from start to finish. End your day the Platinum way.

Flavor Profile: Grape • Berry • Creamy Vanilla

Effect: Calm • Relaxed • Euphoric

Device: Rechargeable 2G Distillate Disposable • All-In-One • Smooth Draw Design
